name: print-social-start-today-gym-posts-cobalt-with-orange-sticker-badges
title: 'Start Today' gym pack on cobalt with orange photo panels, italic caps and sticker badges
whatItIs: Nine cobalt posts with heavy white italic 'START TODAY' headers, photos of athletes on orange-gradient panels, round sticker badges ('Don't give up!'), triangle play marks, dot grids and orange URL bars.
whatItMeans: High-energy and retro-sporty; the saturated blue-orange clash shouts motivation.
techniques: Put mottos on round sticker badges.
Add dot grids and triangles as sporty ornaments.

vocabulary.definition: A round label like a sticker.
Opposite colours placed together for vibrancy.
